requirements.requirement: Every documented register and register range has the family-correct ID, scalar width, sign, factor, unit and access metadata.
requirements.notes: Existing schema tests cover all parsed rows and reverse-check source IDs. They are not proof of structure layouts, meanings, string widths, model availability, or device behavior; those are classified separately below.

requirements.notes: Existing schema tests cover all parsed rows and reverse-check source IDs. They are not proof of structure layouts, meanings, string widths, model availability, or device behavior; those are classified separately below.

requirements.notes: Existing schema tests cover all parsed rows and reverse-check source IDs. They are not proof of structure layouts, meanings, string widths, model availability, or device behavior; those are classified separately below.

requirements.requirement: Every documented register and register range has the family-correct ID, scalar width, sign, factor, unit and access metadata.
requirements.notes: Existing schema tests cover all parsed rows and reverse-check source IDs. They are not proof of structure layouts, meanings, string widths, model availability, or device behavior; those are classified separately below.

requirements.requirement: Decode the product-ID register instance byte, little-endian PID, and reserved FF or Phoenix FE byte.
Prefer command :4; the old two-byte product-ID register response has inconsistent endianness on some builds and should not identify a product without independent evidence.
requirements.notes: This warning concerns the register, not the Done reply to command :4. Raw Get remains available. The high-level command reply behavior is covered by the HEX ledger. No universal endian interpretation is asserted for legacy two-byte register values.

requirements.requirement: Decode every published capabilities bit for BlueSolar, Orion and Phoenix, with zero indicating feature absence.
requirements.notes: Full documented bit sets are independently exercised one bit at a time. Bits reserved by a family are not required to gain another family's labels; the current shared map is an explicit superset.

requirements.requirement: Use product information, capabilities and firmware to establish physical load, relay, rotary switch, BLE/network, tracker and operating-power availability.
requirements.notes: Flavor membership is a declared metadata superset, not a promise every model supports a register. Hardware rejects unsupported IDs. PV-only units may not communicate at night; BLE port multiplexing and obsolete/revised models are device facts. Tests intentionally do not turn absence from a family document into a forbidden raw query.

requirements.requirement: Encode and decode every documented device state/mode value separately for MPPT, Orion and Phoenix.
requirements.notes: Mode synonyms use numeric writes in the acceptance test so alternate wire encodings remain representable. Phoenix mode3 versus prose value1 is classified separately.

requirements.requirement: Enable remote-on/off bit1 in 0x0202 before controlling mode on old firmware; preserve set-only semantics and changes in meaning across firmware.
requirements.notes: Caller must set bit1 once after power-up on pre-1.42 firmware. Reserved bits may be sent and have no effect; only restart clears bits. Firmware <=1.16 reports actual operation, >=1.17 the soft switch. A register codec should not invent power-up state or silently write this mask.

requirements.requirement: Decode family-specific off-reason bits and the old one-byte MPPT representation.
requirements.notes: MPPT bits7-8 reserved; bit9 low battery temperature only fits 0x0207. Orion bit7 engine shutdown and bit8 error. Phoenix only bits0,2,3,4,5.

requirements.requirement: Honor device-defined firmware availability and state reporting, rather than infer universal support from a register name.
requirements.notes: MPPT 0x0205 is firmware1.29-1.43; 0x0207 >=1.44 SmartSolar/RS. Batterysafe and automatic equalization migrate between device state and additional state. Phoenix 0x0207 >=1.17 and BLE announcements require BLE2.20. Orion battery sensing is unavailable without the sensor. These are device observations, not host-side transformations.

requirements.requirement: Encode battery voltage/current/time/temperature scalars and boolean flags in the documented units, including firmware-dependent yield widths.
requirements.notes: All scalar definitions use the exhaustive schema comparison. Independent wire examples verify signed values, sentinels, and both yield widths; these examples do not claim exhaustive value-range testing.

requirements.requirement: Avoid continuous writes to battery settings stored in NVM; select USER before editing protected charge parameters and follow device validity and recovery rules.
requirements.notes: Caller obligation: no control-loop writes to persistent settings. For BlueSolar select0xEDF1=FF before changing annotated parameters; for12V use8..17.4V and compensation -21..21mV. Error119 needs corrected settings plus reset. BMS present auto-enables when detected and can be cleared to resume standalone. Firmware availability/removal notes1-10 belong to the device.

requirements.requirement: Interpret automatic equalisation0 as off and1..250 as a day interval; equalisation current percentage is relative to maximum battery current.
requirements.notes: The host transmits raw days and percent. Trigger timing and current limiting are charger behavior; no scheduler is required of the codec.

requirements.requirement: Offer a selectable small-charger register table for 10A/15A/20A MPPT models, where raw 1 means TYPE_2.
requirements.notes: Regression for F09: MPPT_SMALL selects the small 10A/15A/20A table through typed lookup, reads and writes; MPPT retains the large-model default. MPPT_SMALL is a host API spelling, not a Victron term. Small and large fixtures use distinct model inputs with fixed documented wire values.

requirements.requirement: Decode and encode the unambiguous large-charger, MPPT RS and Orion battery-type values.
requirements.notes: Large raw2 is deliberately not resolved by this requirement; both printed labels are recorded as ambiguity below.

requirements.requirement: Preserve an explicit resolution for the large-charger table that assigns raw2 to both TYPE_2 and TYPE_3.
requirements.notes: SPEC_EXCEPTIONS chooses type_2. Both labels cannot be decoded uniquely. This is not an automatic blocker for the frozen specification; a Victron correction or hardware evidence is required.

requirements.requirement: For rotary-switch chargers, writing FF selects USER; writing another value restores the rotary-selected type instead of selecting that numeric chemistry.
requirements.notes: Caller and device write semantics. The encoder must permit the wire values but cannot force a physical rotary switch. Hardware acceptance remains unverified.

requirements.requirement: Represent BlueSolar automatic and12/24/36/48V settings and Orion12/24/48V settings; keep operational voltage readable.
requirements.notes: The shared Orion metadata is a superset; this does not imply Orion supports0/36. Numeric0 maps to None in the existing API. Encoding and decoding supported nonzero values is verified.

requirements.requirement: Follow model-specific allowed system voltages and battery auto-detection/write/readback semantics.
requirements.notes: Connect battery before panel for auto-detection;36V requires manual selection. Firmware>=1.26 detects only on first successful startup above7V. 100/20 48V defaults48 and does not auto-detect. Fixed-voltage models are read-only. 0xEDEF reports actual voltage;0xEDEA exposes AUTO and becomes writable>=1.17. These stateful/model constraints are not inferred by this family-level codec.

requirements.requirement: Represent MPPT RS remote-input mode0/1 and two-wire BMS enabled/discharge/charge bits0/1/2.
Write RS remote input configuration only while USER battery type is selected.
requirements.notes: Device prerequisite and caller sequence; no hidden BAT_TYPE write should be inserted by a register encoder.

requirements.requirement: Decode voltage-range byte order and additional charger-state bits0,1,4,6; accept16-bit and32-bit yields.
Distinguish total charger current from battery current and respect historical/firmware availability.
requirements.notes: For ordinary MPPT battery current subtract load current0xEDAD from charger current0xEDD7. Historical data absent on old70/15 PID0300. Range registers introduced1.16/1.30; battery-temperature sensing1.42; equalize maxima RS-only. The API exposes documented measurements rather than a derived battery current.

requirements.requirement: Decode all listed BlueSolar charger errors, expanded ranges3..5/6..8 and22,23, and Orion errors/warnings.
requirements.notes: All published numeric values independently exercised. Labels remain the library's existing concise names after checking their meaning; naming style is not normative.

requirements.requirement: Treat documented firmware-specific transient/deprecated error meanings as device behavior.
requirements.notes: Error19 disabled>=1.15;21 may be ignored for5min in old firmware and is resolved1.16;26/38 added1.16;34 removed1.29;116 can follow downgrade>=1.40 to<=1.39. The decoder retains historical values instead of automatically suppressing alarms.

requirements.requirement: Represent signed RS DC replacements, each panel tracker register ID/scale, and off/limited/MPPT tracker modes.
requirements.notes: All16 individual-tracker IDs included by schema checks; independent bytes check all4 tracker voltage/power/current sets and modes.

requirements.requirement: Use tracker count0x0244 and model restrictions to determine which panel measurements exist.
requirements.notes: Panel current is absent on10/15/20A; max voltage>=1.16, mode>=1.42; several registers RS-only. Total panel power sums trackers. No actual hardware availability is inferred from broad flavor views.

requirements.requirement: Decode and encode the low-nibble load mode0..7, independent lighting bit7, on/off state, and off-reason bitmask.
Respect physical-load availability and firmware-specific load thresholds, hysteresis and AES timing.
requirements.notes: Only load-output10/15/20A models; output voltage SmartSolar only. USER modes>=1.15 but24V needs1.16 and old70/15 unsupported. Off reasons>=1.20; AES>=1.26. ALT1 off<11.1/on>13.1V, ALT2 off<11.8/on>14.0V; USER1/2 and AES use documented high/low/timer settings. Hardware performs switching; codec tests do not simulate it.

requirements.requirement: Encode all MPPT relay operation modes and distinguish MPPT0.01V thresholds from BMV0.1V aliases.
Only relay-equipped models implement relay settings and physical temperature/voltage/error-driven actions.
requirements.notes: Modes include >85C and <-20C temperature conditions, float/storage, day detection and load control. Relay dwell timing and contacts require hardware; named enum encoding alone does not validate operation.

requirements.requirement: Represent all six timer words with signed16-bit minute offset, anchor byte1/2/3 and0..100 dim byte.
requirements.notes: Each ID and anchor is tested with independent byte packing and signed extrema. No undocumented host range-clamping rule is introduced.

requirements.requirement: Respect solar-clock, day/night threshold, gradual dimming and firmware restrictions when configuring lighting.
requirements.notes: Lighting>=1.15 on load-output10/15/20A except old70/15. Midpoint shift corrects solar midnight. Gradual dim0 immediate else1percent per configured seconds. Day threshold must exceed night;0 selects defaults; <11.4V allowed>=1.26. Sunrise/sunset delays>=1.26. Explicit time applies5days; FFFF unknown. Midnight anchors require synchronization. Device handles timing.

requirements.requirement: Encode each TX/RX operation mode without confusing digital-output operation with normal serial communication.
Account for TX pulse/PWM/digital modes and their communication/availability restrictions.
requirements.notes: TX1 emits100ms-low pulse per0.01kWh; TX2/3 are160Hz PWM. Nonzero mode disables periodic Text but temporarily answers a valid HEX request. PWM requires lighting; virtual load>=1.17 on selected models. RX available on small models>=1.17, normal polarity mode3>=1.26, defaults depend on physical load. Hardware waveform behavior is untested.

requirements.requirement: Represent restore-default and clear-history commands with an empty ignored payload.
requirements.notes: Restoration effects and preservation of factory calibration are hardware behavior. This test checks valid command payload encoding; HEX transaction/error tests own reply handling.

requirements.requirement: Use history counts and flag04 for empty records, and observe model/firmware/range limits.
requirements.notes: BlueSolar history starts1.16 except old70/15; up to30 backlog days plus today. days_available tells how many to query. RS per-tracker only. Orion newest1070..oldest1098 and cycle count. Empty-history Parameter Error is a device reply, not a host-generated record.

requirements.requirement: Decode every non-reserved field of the19-byte1.16 and34-byte>=1.17 total-history layouts.
Decode all daily-history fields at their documented offsets and units; consumed FFFFFFFF means absent load data.
Treat day sequence as device-assigned identity that stays fixed in backlog and wraps at365 to0.
requirements.notes: Decoder returns raw sequence, including364/0. Incrementing or rolling the sequence is the device's responsibility; no host daily scheduler required.

requirements.requirement: Decode all4 tracker energy/power/Voc fields, sequence and per-field FFFF unavailability in the36-byte record.
Record conflicting last MPPT-history register endpoints: overview10BE, detail10BD.
requirements.notes: SPEC_EXCEPTIONS follows overview10BE and31-day symmetry. Tests pin both sides. This resolved documentation conflict does not automatically block the finite claim.

requirements.requirement: Represent pluggable/internal display enums, booleans and numeric contrast without conflating BMV0x0400.
requirements.notes: Scroll1 and5 are named endpoints, intermediate raw values remain transmissible; the spec does not require assigning them names.

requirements.requirement: Limit physical display promises to models with the specified pluggable or RS internal display.
requirements.notes: Pluggable settings primarily for firmware migration; setup lock/temp units>=1.30. Internal display RS-only; contrast unavailable on rectangular white-on-dark panels. Broad ANY metadata intentionally does not assert those physical features.

requirements.requirement: Represent all remote register formats, network modes, link state values and remote command values.
requirements.notes: Full defined enum/bit values and representative independent scalar bytes. Network-info bit8 contradiction is classified separately.

requirements.requirement: Observe remote/synchronized-control firmware and model support and deprecated-register limitations.
requirements.notes: Remote supported>=1.29/VE.Can1.02, synchronized>=1.44 on network-capable SmartSolar. Notes distinguish2000,2007..200C,2013,2018,2027 availability;2014 only1.17 and replaced2015>=1.19. Equalization requires capability support; commands3/4 not used on VE.Direct.

requirements.requirement: A network controller must forward master data and maintain slave timing/state, rather than merely set the network bit.
requirements.notes: Set networked+slave bits; forward2001,2007,2008,200B Async values and provide200C,200A. Units fall back after1min without voltage. Group-master gathering not implemented by VE.Direct chargers. Wake-up245 triggers role selection; standby bit6 can hold a node while link data is prepared. Library exposes primitives, not a complete network controller.

requirements.requirement: Record the slave-mode overview0x0201 versus detailed charge-state0x200C discrepancy.
requirements.notes: Detailed slave procedure and dedicated link-state table identify200C; current metadata exposes writable200C and read-only0201. No unproven0201-writability failure is imposed.

requirements.requirement: When using external/BMS control, keep setpoints alive and account for the device's persistent BMS-present and fallback behavior.
requirements.notes: External mode sets252 only with voltage setpoint on newer firmware; current-only leaves charger algorithm active. After1min communications loss, standalone fallback; with detected BMS present instead stops with67. Morning black-start permits45s Float. Controlling current, voltage or both is allowed. This is caller scheduling/device behavior, not automatic library writes.

requirements.requirement: Refresh remote voltage and temperature within60s; send reserved values when unavailable and observe compensation limits.
requirements.notes: Remote voltage must be within +/-5V of terminal voltage and compensation limited +/-2V. Encodings and sentinels are tested separately. Callers schedule updates; devices enforce limits and timeout.

requirements.requirement: Preserve the explicit un8 versus documented standby bit8 conflict for Network info.
requirements.notes: Both docs type200D asun8 while defining bit8. Current implementation follows width and represents bits0..7. Neither widening nor inventing another byte is mandated. SPEC_EXCEPTIONS records the unresolved wire ambiguity.

requirements.requirement: Respect the semantics and producers of absorption time, idle voltage, actual/estimated battery current, injected errors and total input power.
requirements.notes: 2008 means available absorption time<=1.39, elapsed time>=1.42, with documented reset conditions. First-starting unit supplies idle voltage. Actual current comes from BMV; estimate sums DC currents. Master injects network errors into2009 and sums EDBC across nodes into2027 on VE.Direct. Tests verify byte formats, not these external calculations.

requirements.requirement: Refresh charge-current limit2015 together with network mode200E more than once per minute.
requirements.notes: Device uses min2015,EDF0, or EDF0 when remote limit absent. The prose EFF0 is a documented typo resolved in favor of the battery-table EDF0. A generic register API need not start a hidden periodic task.

requirements.requirement: Decode Orion identifier plus24-bit0xHHMMLL firmware structure, including FF release suffix.
Represent Orion engine shutdown, delayed-start, delay and input lockout controls with documented widths/scales.
requirements.notes: Schema comparison is exhaustive for these rows. Engine behavior and allowed setting combinations are implemented by the device; no algorithm is prescribed in this public section.

requirements.requirement: Distinguish Orion unsigned output power/current/voltage from BMV aliases and preserve unavailable battery voltage/temperature.
requirements.notes: The battery sensor needs Smart Battery Sense; estimated temperature is charger temperature. Scalar formats checked against table; physical sensor sourcing is a device obligation.

requirements.requirement: Decode both25-byte cumulative user/service history records at every documented field offset.
Decode cycle count, current start sequence and every51-byte cycle-history field, with FF/FFFF/FFFFFFFF unavailable fields.
requirements.notes: Battery type and error remain numeric fields referencing the corresponding tables; returning nested enum names is not required. Version is retained raw; no invented future version format.

requirements.requirement: Represent scalar BLE off/on and every published BLE capability bit without treating BLE mode as a bitmask.
requirements.notes: BMV/Phoenix define only bits0/1; Orion adds2..8. Shared best-effort labels on reserved bits do not assert those bits are supported. Reserved-on-wire future meanings remain unverified.

requirements.requirement: Enforce String20 write payload maximum and decode String32 short/NUL-terminated and full-width product strings.
requirements.notes: Regression for F08: the baseline appended NUL to 20 ASCII characters and sent 21 bytes. BMV_DESCRIPTION now limits the encoded payload to 20 bytes including NUL. The boundary test permits explicit rejection rather than requiring an undocumented full-width unterminated string policy.

requirements.requirement: Respect BMV712-only product revision/description/BLE features and monitor data availability by model/firmware.
requirements.notes: BMV702/712 required for auxiliary/midpoint/temperature features. Precise current>=4.01 BMV712 or>=3.09 BMV70x. Start synchronized availability differs similarly; DC-monitor mode>=4.07 BMV712. Flavor BMV is broad metadata, not runtime model detection.

requirements.requirement: Represent BMV measurements, history, settings, alarms, relay thresholds, display flags and miscellaneous settings with exact table factors.
requirements.notes: Exhaustive schema rows including all table ranges/IDs; independently tested signed measurements, temperature-disable zero, booleans and enumerated settings. Range/default/step enforcement is device behavior and classified separately.

requirements.requirement: Retain the documented engineering-unit ranges/defaults/steps as device constraints; do not confuse field width with a valid setting range.
requirements.notes: The table enumerates all battery/alarm/relay/display/shunt ranges and defaults. BMV rejects inconsistent/out-of-range writes with flag04 and may return nearest valid value without committing it. No undocumented requirement to clamp or reject client-side is added. HEX tests own parameter-error handling.

requirements.requirement: Encode BMV zero-current, synchronize, history-clear and restore commands; preserve declared write-only access.
Record the unspecified read semantics of BMV alarm acknowledge031F.
requirements.notes: The Get/Set table omits all type/access cells and does not mark write-only. Current metadata allowsGet+Set and raw payload. Hardware Get response is not defined and is not claimed verified.

requirements.requirement: Decode BMV SW version as documented hexadecimal AA.BB.
Represent BMV local-change0, epoch timestamps and FFFFFFFF no-modification sentinel; Phoenix treats the shared timestamp as externally managed.
requirements.notes: Raw0 remains0, not None. Setting timestamp does not itself change Phoenix behavior. Who updates it and when is device/application behavior.

requirements.requirement: Decode all signed BMV DC monitor modes -9..8 and preserve signed current/power.
requirements.notes: With correct installation production is negative and consumption positive. That physical polarity is not inferred from the name. Future negative sources/positive loads remain raw unknown values.

requirements.requirement: Save changed Phoenix user settings explicitly viaEB99=1; frequency changes become effective only afterSave.
requirements.notes: Changed registers are volatile untilSave, revert at reset otherwise. NvmRevert loads last save; Backup loads second last or reverts after unavailable post-update backup; Default/0004 preserve calibration. Host codecs expose these commands without hiddenSave side effects.

requirements.requirement: Encode Phoenix NVM commands0..4 and50/60Hz setting using published numeric values.
Decode Phoenix product revision as identifier byte0 plus little-endian16-bit revision.
Decode Phoenix APP_VER with byte1 minor and byte2 major/software-type bits, independently of Orion24-bit firmware layout.
requirements.notes: Regression for F11: Phoenix 00174100 means application version 1.17. INV_APP_VER decodes the family-specific byte layout independently of Orion. The table says un32 but details define bytes 0..2 only; the probe uses zero padding without assigning meaning to byte 3.

requirements.requirement: Resolve Phoenix BLE-capabilities heading0160 versus table0150 explicitly.
requirements.notes: Current choice0150 follows product table and shared protocol usage;0160 is not a separate register. Internal-only write permission is intentionally not exposed as user write access.

requirements.requirement: Decode Phoenix warning/alarm bits and distinguish status reason from shutdown-triggering alarm reason.
requirements.notes: Bit9 labeldc_ripple is historical shorthand for poorDC connection, which can also be a hot terminal on larger units. Test verifies bit identity, not a claim that ripple is the only cause. Alarms represent the cause that stops inversion.

requirements.requirement: Record Phoenix mode3 table versus mode1 prose for multi-compatible DeviceOn.
requirements.notes: Table says3, Note1 says1 and response2. Existing metadata names3 and accepts raw numeric1. Do not reject raw1 or invent which input is the corrected value without evidence.

requirements.requirement: Synchronize communication with Phoenix hibernation wake windows and keepalive requirements.
requirements.notes: Communication begins after a Text frame at least every30s or user button. Receiving a VE.Direct message every24s prevents hibernation; Bluetooth unaffected. This is caller timing/device behavior, not automatically scheduled by the register codec.

requirements.requirement: Observe firmware/capability requirements for lifetime history, AC apparent power, eco detection and threshold limits.
requirements.notes: History>=1.17, power>=1.15. Old eco threshold uses current for1.00-1.14; newer apparent-power hysteresis requires Smart or revision>=7. Min/max registers define clamping. CLEAR normally exceeds THRESHOLD; timing and load-dependent hysteresis belong to device/application.

requirements.requirement: Represent eco retry as0.25s units and load-detect duration as raw AC period count rather than one hardcoded seconds factor.
requirements.notes: SPEC_EXCEPTIONS follows Note4 period counts. Table0.02/0.016s varies with frequency; frequency-aware seconds conversion is optional convenience. Raw count is lossless and is not a conformance failure.

requirements.requirement: Respect low-voltage shutdown/warning/restart thresholds, device clamping and dynamic-cutoff override behavior.
requirements.notes: Dynamic enable0 uses fixed threshold;1 uses current-dependent cutoff and overrides2210/0320. Effective voltage readEBB1. Factors have no public algorithm specified; no host simulation is implied. All scalar widths/scales/access are checked by schema.

requirements.requirement: Represent Phoenix relay values0,2,3,4,5,6 and control/status0/1 with family-specific meanings.
Only Remote relay mode obeys direct control writes; reads always report present contact state.
requirements.notes: Other modes ignore control writes. Mode availability requires>=1.15/capability.0meansNOopen/NCclosed,1meansNOclosed/NCopen. Contact behavior, warning-trigger operation and fan tracking require hardware.

requirements.requirement: Keep undocumented MultiRS/EDF5 entries outside claims of official register-semantic coverage.
requirements.notes: No official row definesEDF5 storage voltage or reverse-engineered MultiRS extensions in the frozen documents. Existing best-effort metadata is not a failure merely because it is additional; behavior of those entries is excluded. No private bootloader registers or VE.Can protocol claims are made.

requirements.requirement: Treat broad ANY/flavor availability as declared metadata inclusion, not evidence every family/model responds to every listed ID.
requirements.notes: Known conflicting wire meanings must resolve correctly by flavor and are tested. Generic extra display/control IDs, single-tracker RS-history exposure and extra reserved-bit names are explicitly best-effort. Hardware availability remains a separate obligation, so these intentional supersets are not manufactured conformance failures.
